## Stock productivity: multiple species, multiple sources

.pull-left[
Fish productivity from surveys, Mid Atlantic

```{r productivity-anomaly, fig.alt = "Fish productivity measures. Small fish per large fish survey biomass anomaly in the Mid-Atlantic Bight. The summed anomaly across species is shown by the black line, drawn across all years with the same number of stocks analyzed.", fig.width=8, fig.asp=0.9}
#out.width='49%', fig.show='hold',
a <- ecodata::plot_productivity_anomaly(report = "MidAtlantic") + 
  ggplot2::ggtitle("") +
  ggplot2::guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1)) + 
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right",
                      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                 plot.title =element_text(size = 11))


a 

```
]

.pull-right[

Fish productivity from assessments, Mid Atlantic

```{r mab-cf, fig.alt = "Assessment recruitment per spawning stock biomass anomaly for stocks mainly in the Mid-Atlantic. The summed anomaly across species is shown by the black line, drawn across all years with the same number of stocks analyzed.", fig.width=8, fig.asp=0.9}

b <- ecodata::plot_productivity_anomaly(report = "MidAtlantic", varName = "assessment")+ 
  ggplot2::ggtitle("") +
  ggplot2::labs(y = "Recruits/Mature biomass (anomaly)") +
  ggplot2::guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1)) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right",
                      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                 plot.title =element_text(size = 11))

b
```
]

.footnote[
Updated from `r Citep(myBib, 'perretti_regime_2017')`
